item.title: Trump threatens 25% tariff on countries doing business with Iran; Details here
item.description: US President Donald Trump has warned that countries continuing trade with Iran will face a 25% tariff from the United States. The move is aimed at increasing pressure on Tehran over its crackdown on anti-government protests.

item.title: Hindu youth beaten to Death in Bangladesh; Eighth killing in 25 days
item.description: Violence against the Hindu minority in Bangladesh continues to raise serious concerns after a 28-year-old Hindu youth was beaten to death in the Feni district. The victim, an auto-rickshaw driver, was reportedly killed during a robbery attempt.

item.title: Lohri 2026 lights up North India; Dulla Bhatti’s story and significance
item.description: Lohri 2026 is being celebrated today across Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, and Himachal Pradesh with traditional fervor. The festival marks the end of winter and the arrival of spring, celebrating harvest and hard work of farmers.

item.title: Market Opening Bell: Sensex rises 201 points, Nifty near 25,900; Benchmarks gain as HCLTech, TCS Rally
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened higher on Tuesday, supported by strong global cues and buying in IT stocks after Q3 results. The Sensex jumped over 200 points while the Nifty moved close to the 25,900 mark in early trade.

item.title: Magh Mela 2026: Sacred confluence of Makar Sankranti and Shatila Ekadashi after 11 years
item.description: This rare alignment last occurred in 2015. It is believed that this auspicious conjunction will resolve all difficulties and prove to be a blessing for unmarried individuals.

item.title: ICC rejects venue change request; Bangladesh to play T20 World Cup matches in India
item.description: The International Cricket Council has rejected Bangladesh’s request to shift its T20 World Cup matches out of India, citing no serious security threats. After a detailed security assessment, the ICC stated that safety levels in India remain within acceptable limits for international events.

item.title: Civic Polls: Mahayuti rift surfaces as BJP moves EC over NCP’s ‘Illegal’ hoardings in Pune
item.description: The infighting within the Mahayuti alliance is clearly visible. Meanwhile, the BJP has now approached the Election Commission against its alliance partner, the NCP.

item.title: Who is Talwinder Singh Sidhu? Why Disha Patani’s rumored boyfriend keeps his face hidden
item.description: Disha Patani has sparked dating rumors after being spotted with Punjabi singer Talwinder Singh Sidhu at a wedding in Udaipur. Talwinder, known for keeping his face hidden during performances, is a popular independent artist blending Punjabi music with hip-hop, R&#38;B, and trap.

item.title: “Leave Iran Now”: US issues advisory for its citizens as tensions rise
item.description: In its advisory, the US Embassy in Iran said that the protests across Iran "may turn violent" amid heightened security measures by Iranian authorities.

item.title: US lawmaker proposes bill to make Greenland 51st State; Full details here
item.description: Florida Republican lawmaker Randy Fine introduced the Greenland Annexation and Statehood Act in the US House of Representatives, aiming to make Greenland the 51st US state.
